implementationDispositionReason: The controller Stage 15 verifier executes the application Stage 11 run-batch machinery on disposable project states. It freezes one candidate, reserves exactly ten current run/context targets, proves exact retry idempotency without duplicate allocations, verifies distinct RUN_ID and CONTEXT_ID identities, binds every run to the same frozen candidate, preserves separate accepted changes and output receipts, and exercises the real Stage 11 completion gate. Permanent invalid fixtures reject duplicate context identity, known contamination/prohibited inputs, wrong candidate binding, fewer than ten current runs, and silent partial-batch top-up. This establishes the application's deterministic run-batch and current-context isolation behavior only; it does not claim independently observable provider separation or a genuine external execution actor.
